text:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up — TerraFlux dedicated rollout proposed for Fri 02:00 UTC (quiet window). Small scope: runtime + model bump. Asking for infra/oncall/CS thumbs and any KMS notes.

Diego Martinez: Can you paste the exact image and model tag? I need to lock the deploy job.

Aisha Khan: Image: `redwood/inference-runtime:2.2.0-tf` model: `tf-core-v1.7-quant`. Slice: `terra-042`.

Evelyn Park: Ran canary smoke in staging. Memory profile slightly higher on tail queries; added `kv_cache_preroll=true` in config and reduced max inflight to 64.

Samir Rao: CS confirms TerraFlux maintenance window, but they requested a 45m observation period at 100% before final signoff. They also want to see the release notes pre-post.

DeployBot: deploy request received 10012 queued by @Aisha Khan
DeployBot: preflight checks: infra:ok, staging-smoke:ok, kms:warning (rotation scheduled in eu-central-1 at 02:30 UTC)

Nora Fields: KMS conflict: eu-central rotation will hit 02:30. Either shift our window or we request rotation freeze for TerraFlux. Recommend freezing rotation until 04:00 UTC.

Aisha Khan: Samir, can TerraFlux accept a rotation freeze?

Samir Rao: They agreed to a freeze until 04:15 UTC and asked to be paged immediately if canary sees errors.

Diego Martinez: Ok. For rollout policy I propose: staged canary 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% over 45m with gating on latency, error rate, and an eval run on a small ground-truth set.

Evelyn Park: Adding runbook rules (ops):
```
# rollback conditions
- sustained p95 > 400ms for 5m -> rollback
- HTTP 5xx spike > 0.8% for 5m -> rollback
- regression on eval suite > 1.0% -> manual hold and investigation
- throughput drop > 30% sustained for 3m -> rollback
```

DeployBot: job #10012 updated: image=redwood/inference-runtime:2.2.0-tf, model=tf-core-v1.7-quant, slice=terra-042, rollout=[3,20,60,100], gates=[p95<400ms, 5xx<0.8%, eval_regression<1.0%]

Nora Fields: Oncall ack. I will watch the first two steps and escalate to SRE if any gate trips.

Aisha Khan: Release notes draft (ops + customer): "Model update: tf-core-v1.7-quant — improved reranking and lower token cost for mid-length prompts. Runtime: 2.2.0-tf — includes KV-cache prewarm fix and reduced tail latencies under heavy seq-len. Known issue: slight memory pressure on <1% of long-tail queries; we mitigated with inflight cap."

Samir Rao: TerraFlux wants prior approval on notes, sending to their TPM now. They also require first-level paging to TerraFlux ops if we hit canary gate.

Diego Martinez: Please ensure the deploy job metadata includes the freeze window for KMS and the customer pager contact.

DeployBot: job #10012: starting preflight in 90s. metadata: kms_freeze_until=2026-04-10T04:15:00Z, customer_pager=ops@terraflux.example.com

Aisha Khan: Thumbs? :thumbsup:

Diego Martinez: :thumbsup:
Evelyn Park: :thumbsup:
Nora Fields: :thumbsup:
Samir Rao: :thumbsup: (terraflux ack pending final note review)

Aisha Khan: Starting deploy in T-60s. Will post canary status updates.

DeployBot: job #10012: canary started at 6219004470, canary=3%

Aisha Khan: Canary passed first gating at +7m. Advancing to 20%. Monitoring metrics closely.

DeployBot: job #10012: canary advanced to 20% at 6219004910

Aisha Khan: (final) 20% stable after 14m, proceeding with remaining steps. Will keep observation period and notify TerraFlux before final 100% signoff.
